name: Compact View-dependent Color
definition: A method to represent view-dependent color using a grid-based neural field instead of storing Spherical Harmonics (SH) coefficients per Gaussian, reducing parameters from 48 to a shared grid.
summary: Compact View-dependent Color replaces per-Gaussian spherical harmonics with a shared hash-based neural field to predict view-dependent color, significantly reducing memory usage and disk space.
